vjimc-2018-cat2-01.prompt:
Find all real solutions of the equation
$$17^x+2^x=11^x+2^{3x}.$$

vjimc-2018-cat2-02.prompt:
Let $n$ be a positive integer and let $a_1\le a_2\le\dots\le a_n$ be real numbers such that
$$a_1+2a_2+\dots+na_n=0 .$$
Prove that
$$a_1[x]+a_2[2x]+\dots+a_n[nx]\ge0$$
for every real number $x$. (Here $[t]$ denotes the integer satisfying $[t]\le t<[t]+1$.)
vjimc-2018-cat2-02.answer: Key fact: $[ix]+[(k-i)x]\le[kx]$. Either induct on $n$ by spreading $a_{n+1}$ over the first $n$ terms, or use Abel summation with $P_k=\sum_{j\le k}[jx]$, for which $P_k/(k(k+1))$ is nondecreasing.

vjimc-2018-cat2-03.prompt: In $\mathbb R^3$ some $n$ points are coloured. In every step, if four coloured points lie on the same line, Vojtěch can colour any other point on this line. He observes that he can colour any point $P\in\mathbb R^3$ in a finite number of steps (possibly depending on $P$). Find the minimal value of $n$ for which this could happen.
